🇳🇱 The Dutch central bank (DNB) has moved 86 tonnes of gold out of New York and Ottawa to London, citing "increasing geopolitical unrest."

The relocation happened between March and August, shifting roughly a quarter of the ~313 tonnes the Netherlands held in North America. New York's and Ottawa's shares of Dutch gold each dropped from around 31% and 20% to 18.5%, while London's share rose to 32% — now the largest single location for Dutch reserves.

DNB says gold in London is more easily tradable and "the most readily available... in a crisis situation," compared to holdings in New York and Ottawa.
